parameters.jsCode: const i=$input.first().json||{};const now=new Date().toISOString();const dealId=i.deal_id||i.dealId;const leadId=i.lead_id||i.leadId;const propertyId=i.property_id||i.propertyId;const channel=String(i.channel||'').toLowerCase();const recipient=String(i.recipient||'').trim();const message=String(i.message||'').trim();const offer=Number(i.offer_amount||i.revised_offer||0);const mao=Number(i.adjusted_mao||i.dynamic_mao||0);const dnc=Boolean(i.dnc||i.do_not_contact);const blockers=Array.isArray(i.blockers)?i.blockers:[];const authorized=Boolean(i.dispatch_authorized||i.authorized||false);let route='human_control',reason='authorization_required';if(dnc){route='human_control';reason='dnc';}else if(blockers.length){route='human_control';reason='deal_blocker';}else if(!dealId||!leadId||!propertyId){route='reconciliation';reason='missing_identity';}else if(!['sms','email'].includes(channel)||!recipient||!message){route='human_control';reason='invalid_dispatch_package';}else if(offer<=0||mao<=0||offer>mao){route='human_control';reason='offer_exceeds_mao';}else if(!authorized){route='authorization';reason='dispatch_authorization_required';}else{route='dispatch';reason='dispatch_authorized';}const key=(i.dispatch_idempotency_key||[dealId,leadId,propertyId,channel,recipient,offer].join(':'))+':provider-dispatch';return[{json:{...i,workflow_id:'WF-367',status:route==='dispatch'?'dispatch_ready':'blocked',route,reason,deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,channel,recipient,message,offer_amount:offer,adjusted_mao:mao,dispatch_authorized:authorized,provider_dispatch_idempotency_key:key,delivery_tracking:{status:route==='dispatch'?'awaiting_provider_acceptance':'not_started',provider_message_id:i.provider_message_id||null},processed_at:now,crm_activity:{type:'seller_offer_provider_dispatch_authorization',workflow_id:'WF-367',route,reason,channel,offer_amount:offer}}}];
